content: {"reasoning": "Prior auth is required and missing, but this payer offers no retroactive authorization window and no peer-to-peer, so requesting either would violate published rules; an appeal is impossible with no denial on the table. The only way to move the claim forward is to submit it, and with strong clinical documentation (0.90) attaching supporting records gives the best chance the auth gap is overcome on first pass, or at minimum builds the record for a later necessity appeal without extra touches. Billing the patient or writing off is premature since the payer has not adjudicated anything.", "action": "submit_with_records"}
